title: CHW and Patient KAP Survey on Antimicrobial Resistance
description: Stream A2 - Community KAP & Drivers. IRB Ref. No. 279/CMHSIRB/2026. Form version CHW-PATIENT-KAP-v1.1 (reviewer revisions applied).
completedHtml:
Thank you.

Your responses will contribute to research aimed at improving rational antimicrobial use and antimicrobial stewardship in Rwanda.

elements.name: consent_info
elements.html: We will collect your name and telephone number to enable the research team to contact you if clarification or study-related follow-up is required. This identifying information will be kept confidential and will only be accessible to authorized members of the research team. Your name and telephone number will be stored separately from the research dataset and linked to your responses using a unique Study Participant ID.
